meta.coordinate_note: All local-frame coordinates: +X right / +Y down on the relevant drawing face, origin at the drawing's top-left corner of the part's bounding rectangle (servo output face for servos; PCB top-left for carrier).
meta.verified_legend: verified=true = read from a datasheet/product page during this session (2026-09-27). verified=false = estimated/[EST]; see dimensions.md register for basis.

mount.note: 4 small drilled holes on output face, estimated from Fig.9 drawing; body bounding box 45.2x24.7 is the critical pocket dim. Corner PA2.0 case screws at ~(1.7,1.1),(43.5,1.1),(1.7,23.6),(43.5,23.6) are case fasteners, not servo-mount holes.

shaft.note: dual-shaft (双轴); rear end has plain O/D ~6mm hole on opposite face.

horn.note: round octagonal flange horn O/D 19.95mm; 4x M3 tapped holes on ~14mm BCD; 4x O3.2 clearance on ~9mm BCD; hub 25T/5.9; horn retaining screw M3x6; flange thk 2.5, hub thk 4.5.

st3215_c018.verified_notes: body 45.2x24.7x35, shaft 25T/OD5.9, connector 5264-3P/15cm, mass 55g, horn M3x6, 4-M3 horn holes = VERIFIED from datasheet. Mount-hole xy coordinates = [EST] measured from the outline drawing (drawing does not label them); shaft protrusion length ~6 = [EST] from horn/hub drawing.

mount.note: 2 ear mounting holes, center-to-center spacing 20.3mm along the length (symmetric about body center); ear hole O~2mm. Overall with ears 23.6 (plan) / 27.35 (bottom view).

horn.note: 28T/3.9 output; horn retaining screw M1.7; stock horn arm span ~15mm [EST].

connector.note: exact JST family not published on product page; 3-pin 15cm wire verified.

sc0043_c001.verified_notes: body 20.3x8.5x19.39, shaft 28T/OD3.9, horn screw M1.7, mass 6.6+/-0.5g, 15cm wire = VERIFIED from product page. Hole spacing 20.3 and ear O/D = [EST] from outline drawing; horn span 15 = [EST].

orin_carrier.verified_notes: board 100.00x79.00x1.57, envelope 103.00x90.50x34.77, dev-kit mass 175g, DC barrel 5.5/2.5/9.5mm = VERIFIED from SP-11324-001. All connector xy coordinates and mount-hole xy = [EST] measured off Fig 4-1 raster (spec gives no coordinates); feet height ~5mm = [EST] from BOM packing note.

lipo_3s_2200.note: Typical long-pad 3S 2200 pack; varies 105x33~35x19~27 by brand. XT60 discharge lead + JST-XH 4-pin balance lead exit one end.

bec_5v3a.note: Generic 5V/3A step-down BEC module; small 2-side PCB with output wires. [EST] representative board, exact size varies by brand.

xt60_switch.note: XT60 inline power switch: standard XT60 male/female housing (~17.5x21.5x14mm body) joined to an inline toggle/rocker switch housing with 16AWG leads. [EST] overall; XT60 housing is a standard part.

fuse_holder.note: 5x20mm glass fuse in inline waterproof holder with flying leads. [EST]; fuse itself (5x20mm) is standard.

imuc_icm42688p.note: Generic ICM-42688-P SPI breakout (GY-class); chip itself is 2.5x3x0.91mm LGA. Breakout PCB ~20x20mm with 4x M2 mounting holes [EST].

rocker_sole.note: Fixed compound-rocker underside integrated into shin_link. Symmetric heel/toe facets; no wheel, axle, bearing, ankle, extra servo, or additional assembly part. Lowest surface remains local z=-54 mm, so standing leg drop remains 138 mm.

bearing_mr84.note: open MR84 = 4x8x2mm; shielded MR84ZZ = 4x8x3mm. Use open B=2 for the shaft pockets.
